findings.evidence: Mathlib/Analysis/Complex/Norm.lean:155 defines `one_le_normSq_iff`; Mathlib/NumberTheory/Modular.lean:832 already uses `one_le_normSq_iff.mp hτ.1` for the identical fundamental-domain implication.
findings.fix: Replace the helper with `Complex.one_le_normSq_iff.mp hp.1` at its use site.
findings.issue: `one_le_norm_of_mem_fd` rederives the norm conversion already provided by `Complex.one_le_normSq_iff`.

findings.evidence: Modular/Orbits.lean:147–155 proves the same norm preservation and real-part negation; OrbitReduction.lean:155–165 repeats their formulas from `modular_S_smul`.
findings.fix: Expose the helpers once in `TauCeti.ModularGroup` with a reusable public name and use them from both files; delete the second proofs and the redundant `coe_S_smul` scaffolding.
findings.issue: `norm_coe_S_smul` and `re_coe_S_smul` duplicate the unit-circle `S`-action helpers added at Modular/Orbits.lean:147 and :152.

findings.evidence: Mathlib/Analysis/Complex/UpperHalfPlane/Basic.lean:137 defines `eq_of_re_of_norm`; the new proof instead derives the imaginary part through lines 179–191.
findings.fix: Apply `UpperHalfPlane.eq_of_re_of_norm` against `I`, discharging its two fields from `hre`, `hnorm`, `Complex.I_re`, and `Complex.norm_I`.
findings.issue: `eq_I_of_norm_eq_one_of_re_eq_zero` manually reconstructs a point from its real part and norm, duplicating `UpperHalfPlane.eq_of_re_of_norm`.

summary: Several private proof helpers duplicate existing Mathlib or newly added TauCeti machinery.
